verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hosted chat web app like LibreChat, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any telemetry or usage-tracking setting, opt-out flag, or environment variable. Being self-hosted, and community worries that telemetry might be added after the acquisition, do not count as a documented opt-out capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
